Earth.chartBlurb: Vector Earth plate for RSS. Sharp at any zoom. 5 bands: -130–0 / 0–250 / 250–1000 / 1000–2500 / 2500 m+. Biome/Slope are elevation-derived proxies until the PQS bake lands.

alt.attribution: Earth Alt plate — adapted from Wikimedia Commons File:World_topo_5layers.svg (CC BY-SA 4.0). 5-band hypsometric tints.

biome.attribution: Earth Biome plate — elevation-derived visual proxy from the same World_topo_5layers source. Vegetation tints (forest / grassland / arid / alpine) keyed to elevation bands; not a published Köppen or WWF biome dataset. Replaced by the live PQS biome bake when the in-game plugin publishes one.

slope.attribution: Earth Slope plate — elevation-derived visual proxy from the same World_topo_5layers source. Higher elevation bands shaded as steeper (red/orange) and lower bands as flat (blue/green); not a true slope or ruggedness dataset. Replaced by the live PQS slope bake when the in-game plugin publishes one.
